senses.gloss:
और्ध्वकालिक और्ध्वकालिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्
(fr. ऊर्ध्व-काल), relating to subsequent or later
time.

और्ध्वदेह, अम्, n. (fr. ऊर्ध्व + देह), a
funeral ceremony.

और्ध्वदेहिक, अस्, आ, अम्, referring to the state
after death, relating to a deceased person, any rite
performed in honour of the dead; funereal, funeral;
(अम्), n. the obsequies of a deceased person; funeral
solemnities; whatever is given or performed on a
person's decease, as burning of the body, offering
cakes, distributing alms, &c.
और्ध्वदैहिक, अस्, ई, अम्, funereal, funeral.

और्ध्वसद्मन, अम्, n. (fr. ऊर्ध्व + सद्मन्),
N. of a Sāman.

और्ध्वस्रोतसिक or और्ध्वश्रोतसिक, अस्, ई,
अम् (fr. ऊर्ध्व-स्रोतस्, a N. of Śiva, ‘above whom
or in whose head is the river or the Ganges’), a Śaiva
or adherent of the sect which gives Śiva the pre-
eminence in the Hindū triad.
